answer_1.quote: we performed a case study using LLMs to generate multi‑perspective summaries (MPSs) of reviewers' comments ...
datasets: ICLR peer‑review dataset (40 papers with reviews)

answer_2.quote: ...we also automatically evaluated the LLM‑generated MPSs. We designed a structured, detailed instruction and prompted the GPT‑4o model to assess the five aspects of MPSs using the Likert scale.

answer_3.quote: we also automatically evaluated the LLM‑generated MPSs... prompted the GPT‑4o model to assess the five aspects of MPSs using the Likert scale.

answer_4.quote: 10 human annotators, all researchers in NLP and co‑authors of this paper, were involved as volunteers... each annotator evaluated LLM‑generated MPSs on five specific criteria ... using a five‑point Likert scale.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated agreement with assertive statements for each criterion (e.g., Core Contributions, Common Strengths, Common Weaknesses, Suggestions for Improvement, Literature Review) on a 5‑point scale (Strongly agree to Strongly disagree).
